author: /root/review_spec
method: Independent model-authored selected word-level English renderings, derived from exact retained English Wiktionary form/lemma senses and separately fresh-replayed Spanish Wiktionary corroboration where available. English renderings are model-authored derivatives, not claimed verbatim source quotations. No native-human certification, invented examples, generic form-rule authorization or complete-coverage claim. Requires independent review before integration.

sourcePins.spanishReplay: 29 selected lexical records freshly matched to original Spanish gzip lines, including raw line newline hashes. Spanish pos labels may be adjective where English labels determiner; corroboration does not overwrite the retained English POS.
sourcePins.englishReplay: Every form and lemma object matched the retained pinned English evidence exactly. The original multi-gigabyte English archive was not freshly replayed.

coverageBaseline.definition: At least one sourced English meaning or reviewed grammatical reading; not every meaning, usage or possible grammatical interpretation. No morphology-only fallback, untranslated lemma or placeholder counts.

guards: Exact whole-word, case/accent-normalized lookup only; do not infer additional forms or accent-fold Spanish words.
Every English number choice is explicitly per word, not generic lemma substitution.
Grammatical gender and number agree with referents or possessed nouns, never invent owner gender or owner plurality.
Retain exact source usage labels only for selected senses; do not import unrelated Mexico slang/Spain senses.
Prior ESTA FreeDict hold remains archival; new ESTA proposal uses independent English demonstrative evidence.
All prior holds, source artifacts, pools, lessons and application files remain unchanged.
Source-derived records require CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution/source links and transparent model adaptation disclosure.
